method: Read-only SELECT queries through the user's existing DBeaver PostgreSQL connection. Results transcribed from visible result grids; this is not a complete schema dump or database export.

completion_percentage.note: This omits drops from the denominator. It is distinct from crediting drops as successes in CPOE and does not identify the CP training target. Rows without a positive denominator were not compared.

model_storage_lead.interpretation: Potential model artifact location; its name and binary column do not prove that it contains the trained production CP model.
